records.what_you_do: Attend a concert from the performances list, go to an open rehearsal, or take part in an Inreach program (iConduct! or Orchestrating Leadership). The sign-up details for these are on their own pages.

records.name: Center for Emerging Visual Artists
records.summary: A Philadelphia nonprofit, founded in 1983, that supports emerging visual artists through a fellowship, citywide exhibitions, and community outreach. It also runs the Philadelphia Open Studio Tours, where visitors see artists' studios.
records.what_you_do: Tour artists' studios on the Philadelphia Open Studio Tours, or volunteer for the tours. You can also see the exhibitions, go to events such as the ART PARTY and auction, or join as an artist member. The site lists outreach to older adults and a Hand-in-Hand community program.

schedule.text: The Philadelphia Open Studio Tours have a 2026 directory and map (tour dates not read). Events are on the Upcoming Events page.

cost.text: Tour and event costs are not stated on the pages read

records.name: Dolce Suono Ensemble
records.summary: A chamber music group founded in 2005 that performs a concert series at Trinity at 22nd, tours, premieres new works, and makes recordings. It also lists education and community projects.
records.what_you_do: Buy a ticket to a Sunday afternoon concert at Trinity at 22nd, or donate. The site lists young composer and student projects (ComposerLab Flute, an online lecture series, a young composers competition, and a community project in Spanish), but does not explain how to join them.

schedule.text: Concerts at 3 pm at Trinity at 22nd, 2212 Spruce Street: October 11, 2026; December 6, 2026; February 14, 2027; and June 13, 2027. All four are Sundays.

first_step.how: Buy a ticket for the Sunday, October 11, 2026 concert at 3 pm (titled Poulenc Woodwind Masterworks), or ask the ensemble about its education projects through the contact page at dolcesuono.com/contact/.
first_step.basis: Concerts are sold to the public with set dates and prices. The education projects are listed without steps to join.

records.notes: Published rather than not_a_group because the site lists education and community projects, though the joining steps were not found. Chamber music has no matching tag in the vocabulary, so interests are left empty. The email address is hidden on the site, so only the phone and contact page are listed.
